**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, confidence 0.78)**

**What I found:**

- **Warranty scope and duration are strong.** Section 9(b) (p0032–p0041) gives Kubient warranties covering performance to industry standards, services free from errors materially affecting utility, no malicious code, compliance with Laws, security practices, and non-infringement. Critically, these run "throughout the Term" with no expiry window — better than the playbook's 12-month/90-day preferred position.
- **The disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty.** Section 13 (p0062) opens with "Except as expressly set forth herein" and repeats the carve-out for "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so the "as is" language is properly subordinated. No edit needed there.
- **The real gap: no remedy.** Searches for "refund," "remedy," and "workmanlike" returned nothing relevant — the Agreement gives us warranties with no stated consequence for breach, and no professional/workmanlike standard for performance.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** a new Section 9(b)(xii) inserted after p0041 adding the workmanlike warranty plus a re-performance / repair-or-replace / refund remedy at Kubient's option, drafted as non-exclusive of our other rights and remedies so it does not become a sole-remedy cap or undercut the indemnities in Section 11.
